definition_used: One or more companies/institutions did not approve one or more parts of the research or publication process(es). RW also uses this reason if the notice mentions a lack of documentation of alleged approval.
semantic_rationale: The definition describes missing institutional approval for research or publication, which implicates authorship/disclosure integrity (attribution_authorship_disclosure_integrity) and governance of the publication process (editorial_peer_review_governance). The problem object is article_general because the lack of approval affects the overall publication, and the process signal is research_ethics_approval_process, with actor_context company_institution.
